data.camera: wide shot, rear three-quarter view, rooftop edge and city below visible
data.description: 千年科学学园千米摩天楼顶的天台上，黑色风衣下摆在狂风中猎猎作响。莉音双手插兜俯瞰着脚下整座璀璨的科技之城，红瞳中映着星火——「整座城市的运作逻辑都在我的计算之内。但唯独你……老师，你每一次做出的选择，都会彻底打破我的精密模型呢。」
data.promptProse: Standing near the perimeter railing of a high tower rooftop at night, Rio folds her arms and looks down across the sprawling futuristic cityscape. Radiant neon transit lines and glittering skyscraper lights illuminate the night sky behind her.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 千年楼顶俯瞰
data.animaCaption: Wind lifts her belted coat above the distant city lights.
